title: JavierGarrido.dev
introParagraph1: I'm a web developer based in Burgos, Spain, working remotely for Kodify Media Group. Most of my career has been on the backend, mainly with Node.js, and I'm at home on the frontend with React too. Before JavaScript took over I built things with .NET.
introParagraph2: These days I care a lot about how software is designed: domain-driven design, system architecture and the decisions that are hard to undo later. I like teams where people learn from each other, and I try to be the one who raises a hand when something needs doing.
experienceNote: I've been part of international teams at multinationals, at startups and, for the last few years, at a product company.

summary: Software engineer in a fully remote, distributed team, working on high-traffic subscription video platforms. Mostly backend: service design, domain modelling and the infrastructure that keeps everything running.
Team lead for the last few years. I look after a backend team: planning the work, reviewing designs and helping people grow, while still writing code myself.

experience.summary: Developer at a Madrid startup, working fully remote and building the product from early on with a small team where everyone did a bit of everything.
Developer at a global IT services company, on projects for large clients. An international, English-speaking team, and a good school for working at scale.

Developer in an international team at a large information company, on products for the legal sector. Web applications and APIs, mainly with .NET, working day to day with colleagues in several countries.
Web developer at a travel wholesaler in Burgos. I kept the internal back-office application running, connected it with partners' services and built the company's new public website, mainly with .NET.

projectsNote: Things I've built outside work, mostly to learn or to help someone.

projects.name: Coconut
projects.description: A web app for remote teams. It lets people in distributed teams share information and keep track of the hours spent on each project. Built with Rubén Antón (obsoftware.es); I took care of the backend and DevOps.
awards: First prize at the MorcillaConf 2019 online hackathon

projects.name: Interfaz en Pantalla
projects.description: My final degree project: an on-screen keyboard and mouse, fully customisable and with scanning input, so people with motor disabilities can use any program on their computer. It is still used in some primary schools in Burgos. Built with Ana Belén González and APACE Burgos.
awards: First prize for equal opportunities, Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (2012)
Winner of the first UBUEMPRENDE ideas contest (2012)
Grant for developing a marketable prototype, Universidad de Burgos (2010)
